content: DNS rebinding defeats same-origin browser checks by re-resolving a domain to 127.0.0.1 after initial validation. MCP Inspector CVE-2025-49596 (critical, CVSS 9.4) was fixed by adding Host/Origin header validation plus a per-session token, mirroring Jupyter Notebook's session-token model -- direct precedent for this phase's D-04/D-05/D-06.
